notes.title: New Update: Version 10.60.0
notes.notes:
[p]Shadow Arena, Minotaur Super Raids, quality of life updates, and more!
 [/p][p]Update 10.60.0 is here, bringing with it a bunch of updates to various game modes. We’re introducing a Shadow Arena mode for Platinum Tier, Super Raids for the Minotaur’s Labyrinth, and a whole lot more quality of life updates that we hope will make your RAID experience that much better. Check out everything that’s coming below. [/p][h2]
Shadow Arena[/h2][p]To offer a more diverse and competitive experience in Platinum Tier Classic Arena, we're introducing a new feature – Shadow Arena – inspired by community feedback and aimed at creating a more exciting competition. This limited-time mode will hide all information about opponents until the Classic Arena weekly reset, meaning players will not be able to see who they are fighting against and team up with Clan allies.[/p][p][/p][h2]Minotaur Super Raids & Quality of Life Updates[/h2][p]We’re introducing time-limited Super Raids to the Minotaur’s Labyrinth, and an indication that shows which Champions have already earned the maximum number of Scrolls they need to unlock all of their Masteries. With this “MAX” indication, it’ll be clearer for players to know who they should switch or remove from the team.[/p][p]We’re also making sure that if you’re running Background Multi-Battles or Auto-Battle in the Minotaur’s Labyrinth and all Champions in the current team have reached the max number of scrolls, the current sequence of battles will end automatically to prevent players wasting unnecessary Energy.[/p][p][/p][h2]Selling Equipped Gear[/h2][p]When managing your Gear, we’re replacing the option to destroy equipped Gear with the ability to sell or remove it instead. You’ll now be able to sell equipped Gear directly from a Champion’s loadout, or through the Gear Filter menu.[/p][p][/p][h2]Doom Tower Quality of Life[/h2][p]We’ve introduced some quality of life updates to the Doom Tower, meaning Presets can be saved across different Rotations of the Doom Tower.[/p][p][/p][h2]Clan vs Clan Points Update[/h2][p]The CvC Points multiplier will now no longer appear once you’ve reached the Points cap for that Objective type. Also, we’re adding multiplier labels to the Game Modes menu to highlight areas of the game where you can earn extra points in the active CvC Tournament. This feature will be made available in-game with the next CvC launch.[/p][p][/p][h2]Clan Shop Items Distribution[/h2][p]We’ve redistributed some of the resources you can earn from the Clan Shop, such as making Gilded Medallions available to Clans at earlier Clan Levels.[/p][p][/p][h2]Champion Filter in the Sparring Pit[/h2][p]Champions that have already reached Max Level will no longer appear when selecting a Champion for the Sparring Pit.[/p][p][/p][h2]Guardian Ring Quality of Life[/h2][p]We’ve introduced a quality of life update for the Guardian Ring which prevents the game from resetting the list of Champions when you’ve previously scrolled down and unselected a Champion.[/p][p][/p][h2]Champion Filter Stat Range Quality of Life[/h2][p]We’re introducing stat ranges when filtering Champions. Now, you’ll be able to sort through your Champion Collection to find Champions with specific amounts of certain stats like Speed or Critical Rate.[/p][p][/p][h2]Gear Filter Improvement[/h2][p]We’ve improved the Gear Filter, so now you can filter Gear by the number of Substat upgrades. For that, simply choose a Substat in the Filter Menu and select an option.[/p][p][/p][h2]Enable Notifications[/h2][p]We’ve improved the ability to receive notifications from the game by adding more clear information regarding notifications in the Profile window.[/p][p][/p][h2]Siege Mana Shrines Improvements[/h2][p]We’ve made a tooltip in the Siege Battle Phase that shows how many Rebattle attempts are available in Mana Shrines. Also, we’ve added a notification when Rebattle attempts are available, along with a reminder to set Building Bonuses.[/p][p][/p][h2]Advanced Quests Rebalance[/h2][p]Old versions:[/p][p]Clear Stage 15 or higher of the Sand Devil's Necropolis 5 times[/p][p]Win 3 Live Arena battlеs[/p][p]Clear Stage 15 or higher of the Phantom Shogun's Grove 5 times[/p][p]New versions:[/p][p]Clear Stage 15 or higher of the Sand Devil's Necropolis 3 times[/p][p]Win 1 Live Arena battlе[/p][p]Clear Stage 15 or higher of the Phantom Shogun's Grove 3 times[/p][p][/p][h2]Champion Rebalance[/h2][h3]Khoronar[/h3][p]\[Skill 1 – Flourish of Slaughter][/p][p]Old Version:[/p][p]Attacks all enemies. notes.title: New Update: Version 10.55.0
notes.notes:
[p]Update 10.55.0 is here, bringing an expansion and new feature to Siege, as well as improvements to Clan Quests, Faction Guardians, the Tavern, and more. There are also some significant changes coming to the Chimera. Check out everything that’s coming below.
[/p][h2]Siege Expansion[/h2][p]As part of the expansion coming to Siege, we’re introducing Tiers 7 and 8. There are new conditions to get into these new Tiers, as well as awesome rewards like Avatar Frames. We’re also introducing more Levels, Groups, and Team Slots for each Building, and we’ve reviewed the balance of Florins required to repair and upgrade Buildings. You’ll receive more Mana Orbs for protecting your Stronghold and Mana Shrines, destroying your enemy’s Stronghold, and rebattling previously-defeated Defense Teams in Mana Shrines. Lastly, we’re making it so that Clan Leaders can now remove a Clan member’s Defense Team from a Slot.
[/p][h2]Siege Traps[/h2][p]The second major addition to Siege is Traps. Players now can add Traps to their Defense Teams during the Prep Phase. Traps provide a variety of unique effects, such as hiding one of the defending Champions or denying enemy healing. Placing a Trap costs Florins and Mana Orbs. Check out the Siege Guide to learn more.
[/p][h2]Faction Guardians Improvement[/h2][p]We’re adding an option for you to Commission your Faction Guardians. This action permanently saves the Guardian Chamber’s bonus and frees up space in your Collection by removing the Champions from your account.
[/p][h2]Clan Quest Update[/h2][p]The Clan Quest requiring you to survive 150 turns or more in a Hydra Battle on Brutal Difficulty or above is being made easier. From now on, you'll only need to last 100 turns.
[/p][h2]Tavern Update[/h2][p]Rank Chickens and Feasts will now be stacked in the Tavern window to reduce unnecessary overcrowding. Also, Champions in the Vaults will be available when using the Instant Rank-Up feature. [/p][h2]
Advanced Quests Update[/h2][p]We’ve also added new Advanced Quests and an option to refresh some of the Quests in order to help you complete the ones you like. Look for new additions with the Quests' refresh at 00:00 UTC.[/p][p]Due to popular demand, we've updated the reward for the "Win 3 Artifacts/Accessories from clearing the Dungeons" Advanced Quest. Upon completing this Quest, you’ll now receive a 1-hour Free Gear Removal Booster, delivered to your Inbox with a 24-hour expiration time.[/p][h2]
Chest Rewards[/h2][p]We're introducing a new Chest Rewards tab, available both in the Battle Info menu and the end-of-battle window, which will be updated for Clan Boss battles. It will clearly show whether the damage you've dealt is enough to earn a Reward Chest.[/p][h2]
AI fixes[/h2][p]We have addressed AI bugs across a wide variety of locations in the game. Check out the full list of skills, Champions, and Bosses that have been affected in the news post titled A Smoother Game Awaits: AI Bugs Fixed.[/p][h2]
Chimera Rebalance[/h2][p]In short, we’re making the Ram Form a little bit easier to fight, and the Lion Form is becoming a bit more menacing. We’ve also adjusted some of the Trials for all Forms as well. For more details read the associated news post.[/p][h2]
Artifact Chest Rebalance[/h2][p]The chances of obtaining more valuable Artifacts have increased. The drop rates were adjusted based on Rank/Rarity, while the Set types remained unchanged. The following chests were affected:[/p][list][*][p]Exquisite Artifact Chest[/p][/*][*][p]Magnificent Artifact Chest[/p][/*][*][p]Elite Dragon Artifact Chest[/p][/*][*][p]Elite Ice Golem Artifact Chest[/p][/*][*][p]Elite Fire Knight Artifact Chest[/p][/*][*][p]Tag Arena Leagues Size QoL[/p][/*][*][p]The capacity of the Silver and Gold Tiers in Tag Team Arena has been increased.[/p][/*][/list][h2]

notes.title: New Update: Version 10.50.0
notes.notes:
Update 10.50.0 is here, and brings with it a bunch of updates. We’ve got a brand-new global event, Chaos Awakes, as well as the return of the Event Dungeon, new Champions, new Relics, and much more. Check out everything that’s coming with this update below.

[h1]New Champions[/h1]
With this invasion of Demonspawn, new Champions have made their grand appearance in the fight for Teleria. There’s the mastermind behind the invasion, Kurosa the Covetous, as well as her Legendary lackeys, Gracchos Turn-drake and Balar the Lost. Next up is our resident anti-hero Dwarf, Tholin Foulbeard, who hunts evil wherever it roams. And stay tuned for a Legendary Sylvan Watcher Champion, Leminisi the Gold-wing, who’ll join the fight a bit later on. Jump in-game now to check them out and read their unique lore via the Champion Lore button. 

Collect all 4 Legendary Champions before 5 August 23:59 UTC to earn a special gift containing an Avatar Frame, the Skull of Treason Relic and other valuables. Collect all 5 new Champions at any point to earn the Chaos Awakes Badge and show off your achievement!

[h1]Chaos Awakes Event Dungeon[/h1]
Take up arms against the fearsome leader of the Demonspawn forces that have invaded Teleria - the Mythical menace herself, Kurosa the Covetous. Venture into the Event Dungeon and receive exclusive Gear for winning Stages.

[h1]Coalition Event[/h1]
Fight back against the forces of darkness in Chaos Awakes with a brand-new type of Event in Raid - the Coalition Event. Team up with other players from around the world to complete Quests, rack up Points, and earn amazing rewards.

[h1]Leminisi Chase[/h1]
Just when all hope seems lost, a Legendary Sylvan Watcher will leap into the fray to help save the day! Leminisi the Gold-wing will be available later on in the Chaos Awakes event for all players to claim after logging in for 7 days, and you can claim her Perfect Soul after logging in for another 7 days. After that, complete specific objectives to earn further rewards!

[h1]New Relics[/h1]
8 powerful new Relics have been added to the game. They can be crafted using Twysted Horns, which can be earned throughout smaller Events and Tournaments that are part of Chaos Awakes. Use the power of the Demonspawn against them to stand against the forces of darkness.

[h1]Oil & Extract Mixer[/h1]
Utilize your excess Oils & Extracts with the Oil & Extract Mixer. Swiftly combine low-tier resources into high-tier ones and Ascend your Gear!

Update 10.40.0 is here, bringing Artifact Quick Craft, improvements to Siege and Relics, a new type of Tournament related to Gear Ascension, rebalances to Chimera Clan Quests, and more! Check out everything that’s coming below.

[h1]Relic Improvements[/h1]

We’re adding Relic Lore which can be found in the Relic Index. We’re also separating the Events Group into several themed groups for better understanding. First of these groups is the Alice’s Adventure Group, and there will be more Groups in the future when Relics are released as part of specific Events. We’re also implementing minor improvements in Relic Storage and Gemstone Storage, such as highlighting compatible Relic sockets when selecting a Gemstone.

[h1]Artifact Quick Craft and Autoselling Artifacts[/h1]

We’ve added a new feature to the Forge called Artifact Quick Craft. It allows you to simultaneously craft multiple Artifacts of one specific Set. To use the Quick Craft feature, you must have at least 1 slot free in either your Artifact Storage or Inbox.

You can customize how you use Quick Craft by setting the desired number of Artifacts you'd like to craft, and manage other settings to automatically sell Artifacts you don’t want to keep.

Artifacts obtained via Quick Craft (including any that are automatically sold) are counted towards any related Events, Tournaments, Missions, CvC or other in-game activities.

Read more about Artifact Quick Craft in the Guide: Forge.

[h1]Siege - Draw condition improvement[/h1]

We are constantly looking to improve Siege, and this time around, we’ve tackled the draw conditions. Now, if both Clans destroy each other’s Strongholds and also receive the same number of Victory Medals, then the Clan that protected the most Team slots in their own buildings will be declared the winner.

[h1]Gear Ascension Tournament[/h1]

We’re also introducing a new type of Tournament, called Gear Ascension Tournament. You’ll need to get as many Oils and Extracts as you can to earn Points, and pick up some great rewards!

[h1]Chimera Clan Quest rebalance[/h1]

Some of the Chimera Clan Quests we created turned out to be tougher than we thought. With that in mind, we’ve rebalanced some of them to make them a little easier - they’re still a challenge though!

[h1]Market Refresh button repositioning[/h1]

notes.title: New Update: Version 10.30.0

Update 10.30.0 is here! With this latest update to Raid, we’re introducing some much-requested quality-of-life updates to Siege and Progressive Chance Events, as well as new features like Live Arena Seasons and Background Multi-Battle. Check out everything that’s coming below.

[h2]Live Arena Seasons[/h2]

We’re introducing Live Arena Seasons! This is a time-limited Seasonal League available to players in Gold Tier where you can win Seasonal Rewards, new Variable Gear Sets, and more! That’s not all - we’ve also added Avatar Frames that you can obtain from Chests by finishing in 1st, 2nd-10th, and 11th-100th in Live Arena Seasonal Leagues.

We’re also adding a brand-new group of 8 Relics that can be crafted using Runed Obsidian. This new material can only be earned by participating in Live Arena Seasons.

The first Seasonal League will start on March 11, so prepare your Champions!

[h2]Background Multi-Battle[/h2]

Another feature we’re excited to introduce is Background Muti-Battle. This allows you to complete other in-game activities while your Champions are fighting. You can manage your account, summon Champions and Souls, or upgrade Gear, Skills, and Masteries. NOTE: You can’t make changes to Champions that are currently participating in a Background Multi-Battle, and you can’t run any other battles while a Background Multi-Battle is in progress.

We are currently testing the Background Multi-Battle feature to make sure there are no technical issues. Therefore, we plan to release the feature gradually to all players, so don’t worry if you don’t see the feature in-game just yet.

[h2]Clan Orders: Attack Priority[/h2]

Clan Leaders and Deputies can now place Attack Orders on buildings in a Siege, with either High, Medium, or Low Priority. This will help Clans better co-ordinate their attacks to focus on the buildings that are key to an opposing Clan’s defense.

[h2]Progressive Chance Event Enhancements[/h2]

You can now remove Champions from Summon Slots while maintaining the increased chances. A notification will warn you that if Summon Slots are empty, the Progressive Chance Event will be inactive, but your chances will remain the same if they have already been increased. Additionally, tapping and holding on a Champion’s icon will now take you to the Champion Index where you can learn more about them.

[h2]Artifact Storage Increase[/h2]

Added 100 more Slots to the Artifact and Accessory Storage.

notes.title: New Update: Version 10.20.0
notes.notes:
Update 10.20.0 is here! Check out Hydra Quick Battle, Campaign Super Raids, as well as various rebalances, improvements and fixes.

[h2]Hydra Quick Battle[/h2]

We are adding the highly-requested Quick Battle feature to the Hydra Clan Boss. This will be an option for players who want to fight the Hydra, but do not want to watch the whole battle play out in real-time. Quick Battle will be available for every Hydra difficulty, but must first be unlocked by dealing a set amount of damage using a single Hydra Key. 

The amount of damage needed to unlock Quick Battle corresponds to the amount of damage needed to receive the highest value Hydra Chest on that particular difficulty.

It is possible to unlock Quick Battle for several Hydra difficulties at once. For example, if a player achieves the Quick Battle unlock conditions on Brutal, it will also unlock Quick Battle on all Hydra difficulties below Brutal.

Team presets and general Hydra battle mechanics remain the same as if the player was running the battle normally in Auto mode. Once a player has initiated a Quick Battle, they cannot interfere with the battle until it finishes. 

Players can use Quick Battle a limited number of times during one weekly cycle. After the cycle is over, the number of Quick Battles resets automatically. It is possible to discard a Quick Battle result without spending a Hydra Key.

[h2]Campaign Super-Raids[/h2]

The good old Super Raids are now available in the Campaign. Save time, raid the Campaign, and get double the rewards!

[h2]Fragments Exchange Lock[/h2]

We’ve added a lock on the Champion Fragments Exchange feature to ensure that you can’t accidentally exchange a complete set of Champion Fragments you want to hold onto.

[h2]New Clan Levels + Clan Shop Items[/h2]

As part of this update, we’re also adding 5 more Clan levels, which all come with the extra Silver for completing Campaign Stages, additional Multi-Battles, and two more slots in the Clan Shop. There are also new resources available in the Clan Shop – Rank 1-3 Basalt, Gilded Medallions, and a Gemstone Box!

[h2]QoL: Champion names in the Soul Collection[/h2]

We’ve added Champion names and Faction icons to the Soul Collection window in the Altar of Souls and a few other places, so you won’t get confused about which Champion Souls you have.

[h2]QoL: Chaos Dust and Chaos Powder amount depiction[/h2]

We’ve also added a visual depiction of your total Chaos Dust and Chaos Powder on the victory screens when you tap the resource icon, so it’s easier to keep track of your resources.

[h2]QoL: Total Stats Window[/h2]

We changed the order of tabs in the Total Stats window in the Champion Collection, so now you can immediately see the stats of your Champion instead of having to switch a tab first.

[h2]Stage Requirement Filter[/h2]

Now, when you tap on the Champions button in the Team Selection screen when taking on Doom Tower Secret Rooms and Faction Wars, you’ll be taken to the Champions window with filters already active.

[h2]Filter out Faction Guardians[/h2]

We have added a new option for the Champion Filter in the Tavern and Empower Champions tab of the Guardian Ring, enabling you to hide Champions that are set as Faction Guardians.

[h2]AI Fixes[/h2]

We have addressed AI bugs across a wide variety of locations in the game. Check out the full list of skills, Champions, and Bosses that have been affected in the news post titled A Smoother Game Awaits: AI Bugs Fixed.

[h2]Immunity Skills fix[/h2]

Another change we’ve implemented is to make sure that when a Champion’s skill states that they are “Immune” to certain debuffs or effects, that they are truly immune to those things. If another skill states that it will place a guaranteed debuff, ignore a portion of the target’s RES, or ignore [Block Debuffs] buffs, it will still not bypass “Immunity”. You can find the affected Champions below:
[list]
[*] Leorius
[*] Roric
[*] Yumeko
[*] Hoskarul
[*] Ronda
[*] Tramaria
[*] Tatsu
[*] Krixia (both Forms)
[*] Acelin
[*] Marius
[*] Falmond
[*] Galleus (second Form)
[*] Aragaz
[*] He-Man
[/list]
[h2]Campaign Boss XP Rebalance[/h2]

We’ve rebalanced the amount of XP earned from Campaign Bosses when facing them on Normal, Hard, and Brutal difficulties, ensuring it’s more consistent. Now each Campaign Boss grants gradually more XP than the previous one.

[h2]New Relics[/h2]

We’ve also added a new batch of Relics, called the Clan Group. Discover 8 new Relics, which can be crafted from a new resource, Gilded Medallions, which themselves can be obtained in the Clan Shop.

[h2]Champion rebalance[/h2]

[h3]Ultan of the Shell[/h3]

[Skill 1 – Under the Skin]

- Skill changed

Old version: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Each hit has a 30% chance of placing a 60% [Decrease DEF] debuff for 2 turns. Each hit will also ignore 50% of the target's RES if Oella is on the same team.

If the target is under an [Increase DEF] buff, each hit has a 80% chance of removing it. This effect cannot be resisted.

New version: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Each hit has a 50% chance of placing a 60% [Decrease DEF] debuff for 2 turns. Each hit will also ignore 50% of the target's RES if Oella is on the same team.

If the target is under an [Increase DEF] buff, each hit has a 80% chance of removing it. This effect cannot be resisted.

[Skill 2 – Resurging Reversal]

- Skill changed

Old version: Removes all debuffs from this Champion. Heals this Champion by 20% of their MAX HP for each debuff removed.

Then, places a [Shield] buff on this Champion for 2 turns. The value of the [Shield] is equal to any surplus heal from this skill.

Finally, attacks 1 enemy. Will ignore [Shield] buffs. Damage increases by 20% for each debuff removed by this skill.

New version: Removes all debuffs from this Champion and heals them by 20% of their MAX HP. Heals this Champion by an additional 20% of their MAX HP for each debuff removed.

Then, places a [Shield] buff on this Champion for 2 turns. The value of the [Shield] is proportional to this Champion's ATK. The value of the [Shield] also increases by 5% for each debuff removed.

Finally, attacks 1 enemy. Will ignore [Shield] buffs. Damage increases by 20% for each debuff removed by this skill.

[Skill 3 – Somnolence Spores]

Fills this Champion's Turn Meter by 15% whenever a [Sleep] debuff placed by this skill expires.

Fills this Champion's Turn Meter by 15% whenever a [Sleep] or [Stun] debuff placed by this skill expires.

If Oella is on the same team, grants this Champion an Extra Turn.

- Damage multiplier increased.

[h3]Konstantin the Dayborn[/h3]

New version: Attacks 1 enemy.

If a target is under [Leech], [Decrease DEF], and [Block Active Skills] debuffs simultaneously, each hit will ignore 75% of their DEF instead.

Decreases the cooldown of the Quietude skill by 2 turns if this attack kills an enemy.

New version: Attacks 1 enemy. Before attacking, steals all buffs from the target and transfers all debuffs from this Champion to the target. This effect cannot be resisted when Vlad the Nightborn is on the same team.

Resets the cooldown of this skill if the target is killed.

[h2]Improvements and battle fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash when Stokk the Broken was involved in a battle against the Hydra.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused the Scarab King’s HP bar appear empty when it wasn’t, when King Gallcobar was involved in the battle.

notes.title: New Update: Version 10.00.0
notes.notes:
Update 10.00.0 is a big one! We’re introducing Relics, a transforming Clan Boss called the Chimera, Champion rebalances, and more. Keep your eyes peeled as tomorrow, you’ll find out more about this new Clan Boss when it is released to the world.

[h2]Relics[/h2]

Relics are a new type of Champion Equipment, different from other Gear such as Artifacts and Accessories. Relics are located in a different tab of your Champion Collection.

Only one Relic can be equipped to a Champion at a time and it provides stat boosts, as well as a unique Ability to the wearer. All Relics are unique and have fixed stats.

Relics can be crafted on the new tab in the Forge using Ocular Masses, received by fighting the Chimera.

A Relic’s Level can be upgraded by spending a new resource, Starstones. A Relic’s Rank can also be increased by sacrificing other Relics or using another new resource, Basalt. By upgrading a Relic’s' Level and Rank, its stats are increased, new substats are unlocked, and its Ability improves.

Relics have 1-4 Sockets, depending on their Rarity, which can be filled with Gemstones that provide additional passive Abilities. Starstones, Basalt, and Gemstones will all be obtainable from defeating the Chimera.

[h2]Champion rebalance[/h2]

notes.title: New Update: Version 9.40.0
notes.notes:
With Update 9.40.0, we’re adding a new Plarium Play Card, introducing some Live Arena and Siege tweaks, an expansion of the Clan Shop, and additional Clan Levels. We’re also rebalancing two Champions and making some changes to the Demon Lord reset timing. See the full breakdown below.

[h2]New card in the Plarium Points Program[/h2]

We’ve added a new card to the Plarium Points Program - the Warm-up Card. This new Card has been designed to offer rewards that are easy to obtain and will help prepare players for everything else in-game. The rewards in this Card include an Epic Dwarf Champion, Morag Bronzelock, and other useful items. 

[h2]Live Arena Improvements[/h2]

We have added a new Live Arena Quest, “Live Arena Daily Wins”, which will reward players when they win 1, 3, and 5 Battles. There is also a new Advanced Quest, “Win 1 Live Arena Battle”, that will replace current Arena Quests for players who are level 60 and above. Matchmaking for newer players has also been adjusted to make starting this PvP mode smoother.

[h3]The Live Arena schedule has also been expanded:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 00:00 - 03:00 UTC
[*] 06:00 - 09:00 UTC
[*] 13:00 - 16:00 UTC
[*] 19:00 - 22:00 UTC
[/list]
[h2]Expanded conditions for receiving Siege rewards[/h2]

Now, if a Clan destroys a Stronghold or a Mana Shrine, or if a Clan’s Stronghold or Mana Shrines remain intact at the end of the Battle Phase, all Clan Members who have set at least 1 Defense Team, won at least 1 ATK battle, or captured at least 1 enemy Team Slot during the current Siege will receive a Mana Orb reward. If a Clan has won a Siege, then each Clan Member who has set at least 1 Defense Team, won at least 1 ATK battle, or captured at least 1 enemy Team Slot during the current Siege will receive a Victory Chest. The same conditions apply to receiving Milestone Rewards, as well as Florins for defending a Team Slot, defeating an enemy team, or capturing an empty enemy Team Slot.

[h2]Reduced cost of repairing Buildings in Siege[/h2]

We have drastically reduced the cost of repairing the Stronghold, Magic Towers, Defense Towers, and Mana Shrines.

[h2]Adjusted Siege ATK Scrolls distribution system[/h2]

Here is how the Siege ATK Scrolls distribution system will work now: at the start of the Battle Phase, ATK Scrolls are evenly distributed between all Clan Members. If the total number of ATK Scrolls (which is equal to the total number of enemy Team Slots) cannot be divided equally between Clan Members, the remaining ATK Scrolls are given to Clan Members according to their Clan Role’s priority (Clan Leader being the highest priority, followed by Deputies, Lieutenants, and Soldiers being the lowest priority). If there are several Clan Members with the same Role, the ones with higher Team Power will have a higher priority. There are also a total of 5 additional ATK Scrolls given to the Clan and distributed by the same logic.

[h2]Siege Victory Medals rebalance[/h2]

We have changed the number of Victory Medals given to Clans for protecting and destroying the Stronghold and Mana Shrines. Defending the Stronghold and a Mana Shrine will now bring your Clan 1200 and 450 Medals respectively. Destroying an enemy Stronghold and a Mana Shrine will now bring you 1300 and 550 Medals respectively.

[h2]New Clan Levels and Clan Shop Expansion[/h2]

As part of this update, we’re also adding 5 more Clan levels, which all come with the extra Silver for completing Campaign Stages, additional Multi-Battles, and two more slots in the Clan Shop. There are also new resources available in the Clan Shop - Chaos Dust, Chaos Powder, and Artifact Chests that may contain Mythical Rank 6 Killstroke Artifacts!

[h2]The Demon Lord reset changes[/h2]

In order to optimize server traffic, we’ve changed the daily reset time for the Demon Lord to between 10:00 UTC and 11:00 UTC. We’ve also added a new restriction for players moving Clans - you will not be able to fight the Demon Lord for one hour after joining a new Clan.

notes.title: New Update: Version 9.30.0
notes.notes:
With Update 9.30.0, we’re introducing Avatar Frames, Rotating Champions in the Token Trader, and new Badges. We are also rebalancing two Champions and adding more conditions to achieve victory in Siege. Check out the full breakdown below.

[h2]Avatar Frames[/h2]

We’re adding Frames to decorate your in-game Avatars. You can get them from various game modes, such as Cursed City, Arena, and Hydra Clash, as well as Events, Tournaments, and more.

[h2]New Badges[/h2]

We have added 27 new Badges so that you can show off more of your achievements – Mastery Veteran, Feller of Demons, and Serpent Slayer to name a few.

[h2]New Siege Victory conditions[/h2]

On October 7, we will add more conditions to achieve victory in Siege. Here’s how it will work after the changes take effect: if both Clans destroy each other's Strongholds and also receive the same number of Victory Medals, then the Clan who has won more attack and defense battles will be declared the winner. Capturing empty enemy Team Slots counts too. Mana Shrine rebattles do not count.

If the number of defeated enemy teams is the same for both Clans, then the Clan who has used less turns in battles will be declared the winner. The turns are counted only in those battles where the Clan has achieved victory. Enemy turns are not counted. Mana Shrine rebattles do not count, neither does capturing empty enemy Team Slots.

[h2]Rotating Champions within the Token Trader[/h2]

We’re introducing Rotating Champions within the Token Trader. These Champions are time-limited with a new Champion rotating in when the current timer expires. Rotating Champions can be obtained multiple times from the Token Trader, should they appear in the rotation after being previously purchased.

[h2]Supreme Club[/h2]

In this update, we are excited to introduce the Supreme Club – a new initiative aimed at fostering a unique community and enhancing players’ gaming experience through exclusive services. This initial launch is a limited test, with invitations going out to select members of our player base. notes.title: New Update: Version 9.10.0
notes.notes:
With Update 9.10.0, we’re introducing Milestone Rewards into the Hydra Clash, as well as adding Siege tasks to the Clan League interface, rebalancing Champions, and more. You may even notice a new structure in the Dungeon Map - keep your eyes peeled, we’ll be announcing more on this soon! See the full breakdown below.

[h2]Milestone Rewards in Hydra Clash[/h2]

We’re introducing Milestone Rewards into the Hydra Clash, meaning you can earn Chests with powerful Accessories as you earn personal Clash Points. Personal Clash Points are accumulated, and are not reset at the end of each weekly Hydra cycle, monthly Hydra rotation, or at the end of each Hydra Clash.

If you claim all the Milestone Rewards, your personal Clash Points will be reset in the next weekly cycle, and you’ll be able to start earning Milestone Rewards again from scratch. If you continue earning Clash Points during the current weekly cycle after having reached the last Milestone Reward, your Clash Points will still reset during the new weekly cycle.

If you reach the final Milestone Reward but don’t claim some of the rewards along the way, your personal Clash Points will still reset in the next weekly cycle and any unclaimed rewards will be sent to your Inbox. If you leave your Clan with unclaimed Milestone Rewards, they will be sent to your Inbox. Your Milestone Rewards progress will also be saved, meaning you can pick up from where you left off when you join a new Clan.

[h2]New Clan League tasks[/h2]

We have added Siege-related tasks to the Clan League interface. These tasks are focused around winning a Siege, and the number of Points that can be earned will depend on your Clan’s current Siege Tier.

notes.title: New Update: Version 9.00.0
notes.notes:
With update 9.00.0, we are adding a highly requested, brand-new game mode for Clans, as well as introducing some fixes. See the full breakdown below!

[h2]Siege[/h2]

On Thursday, July 11, we’re launching the first Siege! It is a new game mode where Clans defend their own Clan Fortress while simultaneously attacking one owned by another Clan. The Clan that destroys their enemy’s Stronghold and earns the most Victory Medals will be declared the winner.

There are four Siege Phases: Prep, Matchmaking, Battle, and Results Calculation. The Prep Phase for a Siege will always last for about 12 days, with this first one starting on July 11. During this Phase, the main focus of your Clan is to upgrade any buildings in your Clan Fortress, set Defense Teams in them, and then set the particular Bonuses and Conditions that will apply across the Clan Fortress. 

There are 5 kinds of buildings in the Clan Fortress: the Stronghold, Posts, Mana Shrines, Magic Towers, and Defense Towers, each with their own specific features. Every Clan Fortress has the same layout and number of buildings. All Clans start their first Siege with their Clan Fortress in the same condition.

After the Prep Phase ends, the Matchmaking Phase will begin. It will last less than a day, and it’s where your Clan’s opponent will be chosen.

[h3]To take part in Matchmaking, your Clan must meet the following requirements:[/h3]

[list]
[*] At least 15 of your Clan’s Members must have reached level 45
[*] Your Clan must have earned at least 50 Clan Activity Stars during the 7 days before the start of the Matchmaking Phase
[*] Your Clan must have set at least 15 Defense Teams in the Clan Fortress during the Prep Phase
[/list]

During your Clan’s first Siege, the game will distribute the Clan into a Siege Tier in accordance with their performance in the last 4 CvC Tournaments. Starting from the 2nd Siege, the game will match Clans depending on the number of Victory Points they have earned from Sieges. Victory Points are given for each victory (either ATK or DEF) a Clan member earns during a Siege. A Clan’s Siege Tier determines how many Victory Points Clan Members earn during a Siege from winning battles, defending buildings and so on. It will also determine the rewards your Clan will receive for winning a Siege.

Once the opponent is found, the Battle Phase will begin, and will last 2 days. During this Phase, you will attack enemy Defense Teams in enemy buildings and observe attacks on your Clan Fortress from your opponent.

[h3]The winner will be determined during the Results Calculation Phase. To win a Siege, the Clan must complete 2 objectives:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Destroy the enemy’s Stronghold
[*] Earn more Victory Medals than the enemy Clan. Victory Medals are given for destroying enemy buildings, or if any of your Clan’s buildings remain undestroyed at the end of the Battle Phase
[/list]

If at least one of these conditions is not met, a Clan cannot be declared the winner. If neither Clan is able to achieve these 2 objectives, the Siege is declared a loss for both Clans. 

If the Clan has met the victory conditions, then each Clan Member who achieves at least 1 battle victory during the Siege will receive a Victory Chest. The contents of the Victory Chest depends on what Siege Tier the Clan is currently in, but it will always contain at least one Fragment of a fearsome new Legendary Champion - Authoratrix Lamasu. You can also receive Milestone Rewards as your Clan collects Victory Medals.

And that’s just a brief overview of Siege! For more details, check the guide which can be accessed via the Info button in your Clan’s Fortress window.

[h2]Improvements and battle fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused [Poison Cloud] buffs to be affected by the Increase Buff Duration effect.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Fyr-gun Isbeil’s Explosive Phoenix P skill to not activate if an enemy died from a Bomb debuff placed and detonated by Isbeil’s Fyrshot skill.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a Champion wearing the Guardian Artifact Set to absorb 10% of the damage their allies received from Poison and HP Burn debuffs.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused battles against Akumori the Phantom Shogun on Auto to end with an error when Skytouched Shaman’s Bloodstain Ritual P skill activated.
[*] Fixed a visual bug on iOS that caused the “Bronze”, “Silver”, and “Gold” text to not appear at the top of the Clan League Info window.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused the Clan Insignia window to not display correctly.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused visual effects from the Tournaments, Events, and offer icons to briefly appear in the Sparring Pit when opened.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused the backgrounds of the Awakening tab in the Altar of Souls and the Champions window to be displayed incorrectly, if the Awakening tab was opened immediately after opening the Soulstone Summon tab.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused scrolling issues in the Faction Guardians tab of the Guardian Ring and Mystic Hand to not appear in the list of available Dark Elf Faction Guardians, even when present in a player’s Collection.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the ‘[Player name] left this Clan’ message to appear in the Clan Chat if a player’s application to join was rejected.
[*] Fixed incorrect number formats and roundings in the Shop.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused additional damage dealt by the Slayer Artifact Set to be capped at 10% of the target’s MAX HP, even if the wearer’s skill did not deal damage based on the target’s MAX HP.
[*] Other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: New Update: Version 8.60.0
notes.notes:
With Update 8.60.0, we are adding a new Divinity with new Blessings, introducing Gear Presets, rebalancing Bosses, and more. See the full breakdown below.

[h2]New Divinity - Harmony[/h2]

We’re adding a new Divinity - Harmony - along with 6 new Blessings. As the name may suggest, these Blessings are about bringing balance to the battlefields of Teleria, and we can’t wait to see how you’ll use them.

[h2]Gear Presets[/h2]

We are adding Gear Presets to the Fitting Room, allowing you to save various Gear combos and equip them with just a few taps. Quickly switching between Gear Presets can be especially useful for taking on the Cursed City, where different districts require different tactics.

[h2]Free Gear Removal Boost[/h2]

We’re introducing a new type of booster - Free Gear Removal - which allows you to swap or remove Gear with no Silver cost for a certain amount of time. While there is an existing booster of a similar kind, this one works on a personal level and not on a server level, meaning you can choose when you want to activate it. Also, this booster will always reduce the Silver cost by 100%. We will still be activating the server-wide Gear Removal Cost reduction boosters, so be sure not to use them at the same time or it’ll go to waste.

[h2]Bosses rebalance (Iron Twins, Al-Naemeh, Akumori)[/h2]

We’re decreasing the stats for the Iron Twins (HP, DEF, RES, ACC), Al-Naemeh the Sand Devil (HP, DEF, RES, ACC), and Akumori the Phantom Shogun (HP, ATK, DEF, SPD, RES, ACC). Also, we are rebalancing some of their skills - see the full breakdown below.

notes.title: New Update: Version 8.50.0
notes.notes:
[h1]New Update: Version 8.50.0[/h1]

Tavern and Clan improvements, Epic Empowerment, and more!

With update 8.50.0, we are streamlining upgrading Champions, adding Epic Empowerment, rebalancing Champions, and more. See the full breakdown below.

[h2]Tavern Improvements[/h2]

We have made some improvements to the Tavern, making it easier than ever to upgrade your Champions. We’ve also added the Champion Filter to the Tavern to help find the Champions you want to upgrade.

[h3]Instant Upgrade[/h3]

We are introducing the Instant Upgrade function that lets you instantly upgrade a Champion's level using Common and Uncommon Champions of Rank 2 or lower. Once you tick the Instant Upgrade checkbox in the Tavern, the game will filter your Champion list to ensure that it only selects Champions that meet the criteria and can be sacrificed.

[b]The following will not be selected:[/b]

[list]
[*] Locked Champions
[*] Champions that can be used to Fuse another Champion, if they have warnings turned on
[*] Common and Uncommon Champions of Rank 3 or higher
[*] Champions with Tags applied
[*] Champions who are currently in Classic or Tag Team Arena Defense
[*] Champions who are currently in the Sparring Pit
[*] Champions who are currently in Saved Teams
[/list]

You can also manually deselect Champions from the list by tapping on them.

[h3]Instant Rank Up[/h3]

Instant Rank Up allows you to increase the Rank of several Champions at once, via the Instant Rank Up button in the Tavern. In the Instant Rank Up window, you can see Champions who can be instantly ranked up as well as Champions and Chickens that will be used as rank up material.

[b]The following Champions will not be used as Rank Up material:[/b]

[list]
[*] Locked Champions
[*] Champions that can be used to Fuse another Champion, if they have warnings turned on
[*] Champions who are currently in the Sparring Pit
[*] Champions who are assigned as Faction Guardians
[*] Champions who are currently in the Master or Reserve Vault
[*] Empowered Champions
[*] Champions who are currently in Classic or Tag Team Arena Defense
[*] Champions who have reached maximum level in their current Rank
[/list]

You can use a special Filter to set rules as to which Champions can be used as Rank Up material and in which order they will be chosen. You can find more information in the Instant Rank up guide, which can be accessed via the Info button in the Instant Rank Up window.

[h3]Skill upgrade improvements[/h3]

All Skill Tomes of a certain rarity are now stored in one slot. When upgrading Champion’s skills, you can use a slider to set the number of Skill Tomes you want to use. You can also use the MAX button to use the maximum number of available Skill Tomes.

[h3]Champion Ascension improvements[/h3]

When Ascending a Champion, you can now upgrade several Ascension levels at once using a slider or the MAX button.

[h3]Champion Filter[/h3]

The Champion Filter is now available in the Tavern, allowing you to view all Champions in both Vaults, upgrade them, or use them as upgrade material.

[h2]Epic Empowerment[/h2]

We’ve added the ability to empower Epic Champions! Now, Epic Champions as well as Legendary and Mythical Champions, can be Empowered using their own duplicates. Empowering Champions makes them significantly stronger by giving them permanent Stat boosts.

[h2]Redesigned News window[/h2]

We’ve redesigned the News window so that it now has 2 tabs: Featured News and General News. The Featured News tab will display more important news so you won’t miss anything important. 

[h2]Expanded immunity list for Bosses[/h2]

We’ve added the [Enfeeble] debuff to each Boss’ list of immunities, making them all immune to that debuff. 

[h2]Clan improvements[/h2]

We’ve added a new Clan role - Lieutenant - as well as some quality-of-life improvements. One of those improvements focuses on allowing those with a specific role in a Clan to send a recruitment message to the Global Chat.

[h2]Numbers UX update[/h2]

Numbers above 99,999 are now rounded using letters K (for thousands), M (for millions), and B (for billions) throughout the game UI. Number formats (dots, spaces, and commas) are also adjusted according to the rules of each in-game language.

[h2]Champion rebalance[/h2]

[b]Hakkorhn Smashlord[/b]

[Skill 2 – Rallying Bellow]

- Skill cooldown reduced from 4 to 3 turns.

[Ascended skill 2 – Rallying Bellow]

- Skill cooldown reduced from 4 to 3 turns.

[Skill 3 – Blood Offering]

- Skill changed

Old version: Sacrifices HP equal to 25% of this Champion's MAX HP, then attacks all enemies. Damage inflicted is equal to 50% of this Champion's MAX HP. This attack is always a normal hit. 

The HP sacrifice will happen even if it kills this Champion.

New version: Attacks all enemies.

Places a [Shield] buff on all allies for 2 turns. The value of the [Shield] is equal to 20% of the damage dealt.

- Damage multiplier decreased.

[b]Claidna[/b]

[Skill 1 – Touch of Slumber]

- Chance of placing a [Sleep] debuff increased from 50% to 80%.

[Skill 2 – Lost In The Woods]

- Effect added: Restores 100% of each ally's destroyed MAX HP.

Old version: Has a 75% chance of placing a 30% [Decrease SPD] debuff and a [Leech] debuff on all enemies for 2 turns.

notes.title: New Update: Version 8.40.0
notes.notes:
[h1]New Update: Version 8.40.0[/h1]

With update 8.40.0, we’re reworking the Impulse and Zeal Artifact Sets, as well as rebalancing Champions and much more! 

We’ve got four new Champions joining the fight for Teleria, including two Mythical Champions in The Calamitus and Toshiro the Bloody, a Legendary High Elf called Wallmaster Othorion, and the first Sacred Order Champion with Faction Unity skills, Falmond Mournsword! Jump in-game now to check them all out, and read their unique lore via the Champion Lore button. 

You can see the full breakdown of Update 8.40.0 below:

[h2]Impulse and Zeal Set Rework[/h2]

We’ve changed how the Live Arena-exclusive Impulse and Zeal Artifact Sets work, turning them into 2-piece Sets while adjusting their Set Bonuses accordingly. 

Impulse will now offer a 12% increase to the wearer’s Speed, as well as a 12% chance to reduce a random skill’s cooldown by 1 turn. 

Zeal now grants its wearer a 20% increase to C. DMG, as well as a gradual increase to damage depending on how much HP the wearer has. At 100% HP, the wearer’s damage increases by 12%, and at 1% HP the damage increases by 0.12%. It’s 3% for every 25% HP the wearer has.

[h2]Champion rebalance
[/h2]

- Skill changed

Old version: Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 50% chance of placing a 100% [Heal Reduction] debuff for 2 turns.

New version: Attacks 1 enemy. Has a 70% chance of placing a 100% [Heal Reduction] debuff and a [Block Buffs] debuff for 2 turns. Has an extra 15% chance of inflicting a critical hit.

- Damage multiplier increased.

[Skill 2 – Ancient Curse]

- Skill changed

Old version: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Enemies killed by this skill cannot be revived.

New version: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Ignores 50% of the target's DEF. Has an extra 15% chance of inflicting a critical hit. 

Enemies killed by this skill cannot be revived.

- Damage multiplier increased.

[Skill 3 – Energy Drain]

- Damage multiplier increased.

[Ascended skill 3 – Energy Drain]

- Damage multiplier increased.

[h3][b]Minaya[/b][/h3]

[Skill 2 – Mending Ways]

- Skill changed

Old version: Attacks 1 enemy. Heals this Champion and the ally with the lowest HP by 10,000 HP. Has a 75% chance of placing a 100% [Heal Reduction] debuff on all enemies for 2 turns.

New version: Attacks 1 enemy. Heals this Champion and the ally with the lowest HP by 30% of this Champion's MAX HP. Has a 75% chance of placing a 100% [Heal Reduction] debuff and a [Leech] debuff on all enemies for 2 turns.

These debuffs cannot be resisted if Khoronar is on the same team.

[Skill 3 – Beauty's Allure]

Old version: Heals all allies by 40% of their MAX HP. Places a [Block Debuffs] buff for 2 turns on Champions under [Increase DEF] buffs.

If a Champion is fully healed by this Skill, also places a [Shield] buff on them for 2 turns equal to 25% of the Champion's HP.

If a Champion is fully healed by this skill, also places a [Shield] buff on them for 2 turns equal to 25% of the Champion's HP.

- Skill changed

Old version: Fills the Turn Meters of all allies by 20% when this Champion is killed. Revives this Champion with 75% HP when killed if Khoronar is on the same team.

New version: Fills the Turn Meters of all allies by 20% and heals them by 20% of this Champion's MAX HP when this Champion is killed. 

Revives this Champion with 75% HP when killed if Khoronar is on the same team.

[h2]Other improvements and fixes[/h2]

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]

notes.title: New Update: Version 8.30.0
notes.notes:
With update 8.30.0, we’re adding new Progress Missions, new Area Bonuses at the Great Hall, and a Battle Counter in Classic Arena, as well as rebalancing Champions and much more! See the full breakdown below.

[h2]New Progress Missions[/h2]

We’re adding new Progress Missions to reflect all the awesome content we’ve added to the game in the past year or so.

There are 180 new Missions coming, focused on Hard Mode Dungeons, Live Arena, Cursed City, and more! You’ll be able to get your hands on rewards for finishing each Mission, with milestone rewards coming after completing 60, 120, and all 180 Missions. Completing all of these new Missions will give you a new free Void Legendary Champion - Marius the Gallant!

[b]Marius the Gallant[/b]
Rarity: Legendary
Type: DEF
Affinity: Void
Faction: Skinwalkers

[b]Note: [/b]You can complete Ramantu Missions and Marius Missions simultaneously, but only after completing all of the Arbiter Missions. 

[h2]New Area Bonuses[/h2]

We have expanded the Area Bonuses feature of the Great Hall! Now, you can also get stat boosts in Faction Wars, the Doom Tower, the Iron Twins Fortress, the Sand Devil's Necropolis, the Phantom Shogun's Grove, and the Cursed City.

[h2]Battle Counter[/h2]

We’re adding a Battle Counter to the Classic Arena. It will show you how many Offense Battles you need to complete in order to stay in your current Arena Tier after the Ranking Period ends.

Note: Staying in Platinum Tier requires Arena Points, and is therefore not dependent on the number of battles initiated.

[h2]Inbox Sorting[/h2]

We’re also adding a new Sorting option to the Inbox. From now on, you can sort items by the date they were received, or by their expiration date.

[h2]Renaming Rathalos Set[/h2]

We have renamed and redesigned the Rathalos Set into the Slayer Set, and Rathalos Material into Slayer Scales, following the end of our collaboration with the Monster Hunter franchise. Any existing Gear or materials will be converted, and any converted resources from the collaboration will be compatible with the newly-named resources. The balance of the Gear Set will remain the same.

[h2]Champion rebalance[/h2]

[b]Little Miss Annie[/b]

[Skill 1 – Pretty Nails]
- Skill changed.
Old version: Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. Each hit has a 50% chance of placing a 100% [Heal Reduction] debuff for 2 turns.

New version: Attacks 1 enemy 3 times. Each hit has a 50% chance of placing a 100% [Heal Reduction] debuff and a 60% [Decrease DEF] debuff for 2 turns.

[Skill 2 – Hollow Doll]
- Skill changed.
Old version: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Places a 50% [Increase ATK] buff on this Champion for 2 turns before attacking if the target is under a [Shield] buff. Will ignore 25% of the target's DEF if the target is under a [Shield] buff. 

Places a [Perfect Veil] buff on this Champion for 2 turns if this attack kills an enemy.

Fills this Champion's Turn Meter by 30% if this attack does not kill the target.

New version: Attacks 1 enemy 2 times. Before attacking, places a 50% [Increase ATK] buff on this Champion for 2 turns. Will ignore 25% of the target's DEF. 

Also places a [Perfect Veil] buff on this Champion for 2 turns.

Then, fills this Champion's Turn Meter by 30%.

[Skill 3 – Playdate]
- Skill changed.
Old version: Attacks 1 enemy. Will ignore 25% of the target's DEF if the target has higher DEF than this Champion. Destroys the target's MAX HP by 25% of the damage inflicted if the target has higher MAX HP than this Champion.

Will repeat attack a second time if the target has both higher DEF and higher MAX HP than this Champion.

New version: Attacks 1 enemy. Will ignore 25% of the target's DEF. Destroys the target's MAX HP by 25% of the damage inflicted.

Will repeat the attack if the target has both higher DEF and higher MAX HP than this Champion.

Also places a [Revive On Death] buff on this Champion for 2 turns if this attack kills an enemy.

[Skill 5 – Magical Heart [P]]
- Skill changed.
Old version: Each hit has a 50% chance of decreasing the target's Turn Meter by 5% and a 100% chance of destroying the target's MAX HP by 5% of the damage inflicted when attacking enemies under [Heal Reduction] debuffs.

Also heals this Champion by 5% of the damage inflicted when attacking enemies under [Heal Reduction] debuffs.

[Will not heal from damage inflicted by Masteries]

New version: Each hit has a 50% chance of decreasing the target's Turn Meter by 10% and a 100% chance of destroying the target's MAX HP by 10% of the damage inflicted when attacking enemies under [Heal Reduction] or [Decrease DEF] debuffs.

Also heals this Champion by 10% of the damage inflicted when attacking enemies under [Heal Reduction] or [Decrease DEF] debuffs.

[Will not heal from damage inflicted by Masteries]

[b]Supreme Athel[/b]

[Skill 1 – Exemplar of Stoicism]
- Damage multiplier increased.

[Skill 2 – Cold Company]
- Skill changed.
Old version: Attacks all enemies. Will ignore [Strengthen], [Ally Protection] and [Unkillable] buffs on enemies under a [Freeze] debuff. 

Then, has a 100% chance of placing a [Freeze] debuff for 1 turn.

New version: Attacks all enemies. Before attacking, has a 100% chance of placing a [Freeze] debuff for 1 turn.

Will ignore [Strengthen], [Ally Protection] and [Unkillable] buffs, as well as 20% of the target's DEF when attacking enemies under a [Freeze] debuff.

- Damage multiplier increased.

[Skill 3 – Ever Faithful]
- Skill changed.
Old version: Places a 50% [Increase ATK] buff, a 30% [Increase C. RATE] buff and a [Shield] buff on this Champion for 3 turns, then grants an Extra Turn. The value of the [Shield] is proportional to this Champion's ATK.

New version: Places a 50% [Increase ATK] buff, a 30% [Increase C. RATE] buff, a [Shield] buff, and a 50% [Increase ACC] buff on this Champion for 3 turns, then grants an Extra Turn. 

The value of the [Shield] is proportional to this Champion's ATK.

[b]Siegfrund the Nephilim, Base Form[/b]

[Skill 1 – Excoriating Edge]
- Damage multiplier increased.

[Skill 2 – Seraphic Wave]
- Damage multiplier increased.

[Skill 3 – Rage of the Nephilim]
- Skill changed.
Old version: Attacks 1 enemy. Will attack all remaining enemies with any surplus damage if the initial target is killed. 

Fully heals this Champion if the initial hit kills an enemy.

New version: Attacks 1 enemy. Ignores 50% of the target's DEF. Will attack all remaining enemies with any surplus damage if the initial target is killed. 

Fully heals this Champion if the initial hit kills an enemy.

- Damage multiplier increased.

[Skill 5 – Stay the Blade [P]]
- Skill changed.

Then, heals this Champion by 50% of their MAX HP and fills their Turn Meter by 100%.

[Skill 3 – Light of the Beyond]
- Skill changed.
Old version: Revives all dead allies with 50% HP and 50% Turn Meter, then places a [Block Damage] buff on all allies except this Champion for 1 turn.

New version: Revives all dead allies with 50% HP and 50% Turn Meter, then places a [Block Damage] buff on all allies for 2 turns.

[h2]Other improvements and battle fixes[/h2]

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]

notes.title: New Update: Version 8.20
notes.notes:
With update 8.20.0, we are adding a new type of skill and the opportunity to exchange unused Champion Fragments for useful resources. We are also making Super Raids permanent, as well as implementing some other improvements and fixes. You can check the full breakdown of these changes in this piece of news.

But that’s not all - we are also rebalancing Blessings and increasing your chances of summoning Perfect Souls for specific Champions on your Wishlist. We’ll post a separate piece of news about these changes, so keep an eye out for that!

[h2]Faction Unity Skills[/h2]

Faction Unity skills are a brand-new type of skill that have their power enhanced when a player has multiple Champions from the same Faction on their team. The more allies from the same Faction, the more powerful a Faction Unity skill becomes. Champions who have Faction Unity skills will also have enhanced Aura skills that increase two stats rather than one.

Champions with Faction Unity skills are important figures from Teleria’s past and present, related to each Faction. As these Champions are particularly special, they won’t normally be summonable from Shards and will only be available from select in-game events. Keep an eye on the News to find out how and when you can get them, and don’t miss out on getting the first Champion with Faction Unity skills - Acelin the Stalwart!

[h2]Exchanging Champion Fragments[/h2]

Over the years, you might have accumulated hundreds of Champion Fragments with no way to use them. Well, now you can - introducing Fragment Exchange!

You can now swap your unused Champion Fragments for Exchange Points if you are unable to earn more Fragments for that specific Champion. You can then spend your Exchange Points on Fragment Exchange Chests. Each Chest contains useful items that will help you progress, as well as Fragments of a unique Legendary Champion from the Sacred Order, Highmother Maud. Head to the Fragment Summon tab in the Portal to find out the details.

[h2]Live Arena adjustments[/h2]

Players in Gold I and Gold II will now lose 3 Live Arena Points per battle loss instead of 4. We’ve also shortened the maximum battle duration from 30 to 20 minutes.

[h1]Permanent Super Raids[/h1]

Super Raids will now be permanently available in the Doom Tower, Faction Wars, Gear Dungeons, and Gear Ascension Dungeons. Also, if you activate Super Raids during a CvC Tournament, the CvC Points you receive will be doubled.
